recommended_learning_path.rationale: Although the student has Python basics, taking the Data Structures & Algorithms course is crucial for a solid foundation in programming and AI, as it is a prerequisite for the Applied Machine Learning & Computer Vision course.

overall_summary: The student has a solid foundation in Python basics and can start with the Data Structures & Algorithms course, which will unlock more advanced courses like Applied Machine Learning & Computer Vision, ultimately leading to their career goal of becoming a Full-Stack AI Developer.
